summary_en: 3,000,000 shares (1.9% of shares outstanding) | ¥3.5B upper limit | price ceiling not disclosed | execution window 2026-08-13 to 2026-12-31 | method: market purchase via discretionary investment contract on TSE | intention to cancel all acquired shares plus existing treasury (except ESOP allocation reserve) by end-December 2026.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: JAC Recruitment's board resolved on 12 August 2026 to acquire and subsequently cancel treasury shares under articles 165(3) and 178 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 3,000,000 shares (1.9% of the 158,914,131 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥3.5 billion. Acquisition will occur via market purchase under a discretionary investment contract on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 13 August and 31 December 2026. No price ceiling was disclosed. All acquired shares will be cancelled by end-December 2026, together with existing treasury holdings not reserved for restricted-share awards and employee compensation programs. The company currently holds 6,643,069 treasury shares (including 857,641 shares held in ESOP trust). The rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder value in response to changing business conditions.
